notablePrerequisites: Zhur-Taa Druid and Elite Arcanist do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Triton Tactics without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Triton Tactics, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid and Elite Arcanist and giving them +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
